    outline = build_outline(lines)
    if isinstance(outline, dict):
        return outline

    while position >= 0:
        stack.append((outline[position], str(position + 1)))
        position -= 1
    while stack:
        node, number = stack.pop()
        level = node["level"]

            continue
        entries.append({"number": number, "title": node["title"]})
        children = node["children"]
        child_pos = len(children) - 1
        while child_pos >= 0:
            stack.append((children[child_pos], number + "." + str(child_pos + 1)))
            child_pos -= 1
    return entries
```
